name: Tank
description: The Tank is a line of watches made by Cartier. It was created by Louis Cartier in 1917, and inspired by the new Renault tanks which Cartier saw in use on the Western Front. The prototype watch was presented by Cartier to General John J. Pershing of the American Expeditionary Force.

name: Calatrava
description: The Patek Philippe Calatrava is a line of dress watches built by Swiss watchmaker Patek Philippe. Known for its simple and elegant design, the Calatrava wristwatch has been a flagship model of Patek Philippe since its introduction.

name: Reverso
description: A rectangular watch whose case flips over on a sprung carriage, protecting the dial. Created in 1931 for polo players and still made in Le Sentier.

name: Lange 1
description: German manual-wind watch with an off-centre dial, outsize date and power reserve indicator. Movement finished and assembled by hand in Glashütte.

name: Cellini
description: Rolex's dress-watch family: slim gold cases, domed bezels and classic dials, without the sports-watch bracelet.

name: Submariner
description: The Rolex Submariner is a line of sports watches designed for diving and manufactured by Rolex, resistant to water and corrosion. The first Submariner was introduced to the public in 1954 at the Basel Watch Fair.

name: Seamaster
description: The Omega Seamaster is a line of automatic winding mechanical sports and diving watches from Omega with a history that can be traced back to the original water-resistant dress-style watch released in 1948.

name: Royal Oak
description: The octagonal steel sports watch with an exposed-screw bezel and integrated bracelet, introduced in 1972.

name: Nautilus
description: Integrated-bracelet sports watch with a porthole-shaped case, introduced in 1976 and designed by Gérald Genta.

name: GMT-Master II
description: A travel watch that shows a second time zone with a 24-hour hand, in steel with a two-colour ceramic bezel.

name: Luminor
description: Italian dive-watch heritage in a large cushion case, with the signature crown-protecting bridge and luminous dial.

name: Speedmaster Professional
description: Omega Speedmaster is a line of luxury chronograph wristwatches produced by Omega SA. While chronographs have existed since the late 1800s, Omega first introduced this line of chronographs in 1957. Since then, many different chronograph movements have been marketed under the Speedmaster name.

name: Cosmograph Daytona
description: The Rolex Cosmograph Daytona is a mechanical chronograph wristwatch designed to meet the needs of racing drivers by measuring elapsed time and calculating average speed. Its name refers to Daytona Beach, Florida, where racing flourished in the early 20th century.

name: Monaco
description: The TAG Heuer Monaco, initially introduced by Heuer in 1969, is a line of automatic chronograph wristwatches created to commemorate the Monaco Grand Prix.

name: Navitimer
description: The Breitling Navitimer is a watch that was released in 1954 in Switzerland by Breitling SA. Since then it has been one of the best selling watches produced by Breitling.

name: El Primero
description: El Primero is a steam yacht that was built in 1893. This vessel was once considered one of the most luxurious yachts on the West Coast of the United States, and was one of the few steam yachts to be operated on Puget Sound.

name: Birkin
description: The hand-stitched leather bag named after Jane Birkin, made by a single artisan and recognised by its flap, turn lock and two handles.

name: Kelly
description: The Kelly bag is a leather handbag created in the 1930s by the company Hermès and named after American actress and Princess of Monaco Grace Kelly. It is one of the brand's iconic products, along with the Carré de soie and the Birkin bag.

name: Classic Flap (2.55)
description: The Chanel 2.55 is a luxury leather handbag or purse designed by Coco Chanel and manufactured by the fashion house of Chanel.

name: Speedy
description: A compact monogram-canvas handbag with rolled leather handles, a daily classic from the house since the 1930s.

name: Lady Dior
description: Lady Dior is a commercial name given to a handbag by the Christian Dior company in honor of Diana, Princess of Wales. It was designed by Gianfranco Ferré in 1994 under the name Chouchou, and was later renamed as Princesse before being renamed as Lady Dior.

name: Baguette
description: The small shoulder bag worn tucked under the arm, launched in 1997 and offered in countless embellished editions.

name: Saddle Bag
description: The Dior Saddle bag is a designer handbag introduced in 1999 by French fashion house Dior under the creative direction of John Galliano.

name: Jackie 1961
description: A slouchy hobo shoulder bag with a piston closure, reissued from the 1960s original named after Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis.

name: Keepall
description: The soft-sided travel bag in monogram canvas, designed in 1930 as a weekend companion that folds when empty.

name: Neverfull
description: A roomy open tote in monogram canvas with side laces to adjust the shape, and a removable zipped pouch.

name: Classic Cabin
description: The grooved aluminium cabin suitcase from Cologne, lightweight, dent-tolerant and built to take years of travel.

name: Saint Louis Tote
description: A reversible tote in hand-painted goyardine canvas, unlined and lightweight, with no logo beyond the chevron pattern.

name: Venezia Leather Briefcase
description: A slim briefcase in Venezia calfskin, hand-dyed so each piece develops its own patina with use.

name: N°5 Eau de Parfum
description: Chanel No. 5 is the first perfume launched by French couturier Gabrielle "Coco" Chanel in 1921. The scent formula for the fragrance was compounded by French-Russian chemist and perfumer Ernest Beaux. The design of its bottle has been an important part of the product's branding.

name: J'adore Eau de Parfum
description: A floral bouquet of ylang-ylang, rose and jasmine in a bottle shaped like an amphora, created in 1999.

name: Shalimar
description: Shalimar is a perfume originally created by Jacques Guerlain in 1921 for French perfume and cosmetics house Guerlain. In production continuously since 1925, Shalimar is currently a flagship product for Guerlain.

name: Coco Mademoiselle
description: Coco Mademoiselle is a women's perfume by French fashion house Chanel, introduced in 2001 for younger consumers. The fragrance was created by Jacques Polge, the nose of Chanel from 1978 to 2015.

name: Miss Dior
description: Miss Dior is a 1947 perfume released by Christian Dior.

name: Opium
description: Opium is an Oriental-spicy perfume for women, created for the French fashion house Yves Saint Laurent by perfumers Jean Amic and Jean-Louis Sieuzac.

name: Sauvage Eau de Parfum
description: Sauvage is a line of men's fragrances produced by Parfums Christian Dior. The original eau de toilette, composed by the house's in-house perfumer François Demachy, was released in 2015, with the actor Johnny Depp as the face of its advertising.

name: Bleu de Chanel
description: Bleu de Chanel is a men's fragrance created by Jacques Polge for French fashion house Chanel in 2010. It was the first men's fragrance released by the brand since Allure Homme Sport in 2004, and the first men's masterbrand introduced since Égoïste in 1990.

name: Aventus
description: A fruity, smoky niche fragrance built on pineapple, birch and musk, launched in 2010 by the house of Creed.

name: Eau Sauvage
description: Eau Sauvage is a perfume for men produced by Parfums Christian Dior. It was created by perfumer Edmond Roudnitska and introduced in 1966 as Dior's first scent for men. The name of the fragrance is reputedly the result of a late arrival by Christian Dior's friend Percy Savage to Dior's home.

name: Terre d'Hermès
description: Terre d'Hermès is a fragrance launched by French luxury brand Hermès in March 2006. It was created by Jean-Claude Ellena, who was the exclusive in-house perfumer of Hermès.

name: Acqua di Giò
description: Acqua di Giò is a men's fragrance released by Giorgio Armani in 1996. It was composed by the perfumer Alberto Morillas and is produced under licence by L'Oréal Luxe. It has remained in production since its launch and was inducted into the Fragrance Foundation's Hall of Fame in 2012.

name: Aviator Classic
description: Aviator sunglasses are a style of sunglasses that was developed by a group of American firms. The original Bausch & Lomb design is now commercially marketed as Ray-Ban Aviators, although other manufacturers also produce aviator-style sunglasses.

name: Wayfarer
description: Ray-Ban Wayfarer sunglasses and eyeglasses have been manufactured by Ray-Ban since 1952.

name: Clubmaster
description: Browline frames pairing a bold acetate upper rim with metal lower edges, a 1950s optical style reintroduced as sunglasses.

name: 649 Original
description: Italian acetate sunglasses with the Meflecto flexible temples and the silver arrow, made in the 1950s for tram drivers.

name: Gregory Peck
description: Round acetate frames named after the actor, with a keyhole bridge and gold-toned detailing.

name: Santos de Cartier Sunglasses
description: Aviator-style sunglasses with gold-finish metal frames and the signature screw detail of the Santos family.

name: Love Bracelet
description: The screw-motif gold bracelet designed in 1969, locked on with a screwdriver as a sign of lasting commitment.

name: Juste un Clou
description: A gold bracelet shaped like a bent nail, an everyday object turned into jewellery in the 1970s.

name: Tiffany Setting Ring
description: The six-prong solitaire engagement ring introduced in 1886 that lifts the diamond to catch the light.

name: Serpenti Bracelet
description: A coiled serpent in gold with a scale texture, a motif the Roman jeweller has made since the 1940s.

name: Trinity Ring
description: Three interlocking bands of yellow, white and rose gold, a design first made in 1924.

name: Vintage Alhambra Necklace
description: A chain of four-leaf clover motifs in gold and mother of pearl, inspired by good luck.

name: Return to Tiffany Heart Tag
description: A sterling silver heart tag pendant engraved with the Return to Tiffany inscription.

name: Akoya Pearl Strand
description: A strand of cultured Akoya pearls graded for lustre and matching, with a gold clasp. Mikimoto pioneered pearl culturing.

name: B.zero1 Earrings
description: Gold spiral earrings echoing the Colosseum-inspired ring pattern of the house's best-known collection.

name: Kensington Trench Coat
description: A double-breasted gabardine trench with storm flap, belt and horn-effect buttons, in the house's heritage cut.

name: Maya Down Jacket
description: A quilted down jacket in glossy nylon with a high collar, light enough to wear all winter.

name: Beaufort Waxed Jacket
description: The waxed cotton field jacket with corduroy collar and game pocket, weatherproof since the 1980s.

name: Storm System Overcoat
description: A cashmere overcoat with a wind-resistant membrane, tailored in Italy from the maker's own fibres.

name: Cashmere Crewneck
description: A fine-gauge crewneck knitted from baby cashmere, very soft and light enough to layer.

name: Cashmere Turtleneck
description: A rib-knit turtleneck in pure cashmere, finished in the muted palette typical of the Solomeo house.

name: Silk Carré 90
description: A 90 cm square silk twill scarf with hand-rolled edges, printed in up to forty colours.

name: Check Cashmere Scarf
description: A soft cashmere scarf in the house check, brushed for warmth and finished with a fringe.

name: Tweed Jacket
description: The collarless bouclé jacket with braided trim and gold buttons that has defined the house's tailoring since the 1950s.

name: Le Smoking Tuxedo
description: Le Smoking is a women's tuxedo suit created in 1966 by couturier Yves Saint Laurent.

name: Bespoke Wool Suit
description: A hand-tailored wool suit from the Roman house, cut with a soft shoulder and a clean drape.

name: Trofeo Wool Suit
description: A suit in Trofeo wool woven from fine fibres, with a natural stretch and a refined drape.

name: So Kate Pump
description: A stiletto pump with a pointed toe and the lacquered red sole that has been the designer's signature since 1993.

name: BB Pump
description: A pointed-toe satin pump with a slender heel, hand-finished in Italy for the London shoemaker.

name: Two-Tone Slingback
description: A beige slingback with a black cap toe, a design that lengthens the leg and has been worn since 1957.

name: Azia Sandal
description: A strappy stiletto sandal in metallic leather with a slim ankle strap, handmade in Italy.

name: Horsebit 1953 Loafer
description: A leather loafer with the gold horsebit across the vamp, a detail the house first used in 1953.

name: Alessandro Oxford
description: A one-piece calf leather oxford with a hand-applied patina, the maker's signature lace-up since the 1890s.

name: Consul Oxford
description: A Goodyear-welted black calf oxford from the Northampton maker, polished to a deep shine.

name: Gancini Loafer
description: A smooth calf loafer with the Gancini ornament, made in Italy by the house founded by Salvatore Ferragamo.

name: Achilles Low
description: The minimalist white leather sneaker with a gold serial number on the heel, made in Italy.

name: Super-Star
description: A leather sneaker with a star patch and a deliberately worn finish, hand-distressed in Venice.

name: Ace Sneaker
description: A low-top white leather sneaker with an embroidered bee and a green and red web stripe.

name: B23 High-Top
description: A high-top sneaker in the house's Oblique canvas with a signature B23 side stripe.

name: H Belt Buckle & Reversible Strap
description: A palladium H buckle with a reversible calfskin strap, black on one side and brown on the other.

name: GG Marmont Belt
description: A leather belt with a double-G buckle in aged gold, a motif drawn from the house's archive.

name: Slender Wallet
description: A slim bifold in monogram canvas with card slots and a note compartment, sized for a front pocket.

name: Bearn Wallet
description: A long wallet with a gusseted compartment, a clasp in the shape of an H and a leather lining.

name: Meisterstück 149
description: The large black resin fountain pen with a hand-fitted 18-carat gold nib, in production since the 1920s.

name: 51 Fountain Pen
description: The Parker 51 is a fountain pen first introduced in 1941. Parker marketed it as "The World’s Most Wanted Pen", a slogan alluding to restrictions on production of consumer goods for civilian markets in the United States during World War II.

name: Souverän M800
description: A piston-fill fountain pen in striped green resin with a 18-carat two-tone nib, made in Germany.

name: Panama Notebook
description: A notebook in cross-grain leather with the house's feather-weight paper, from a British maker founded in 1887.

name: Rollagas Lighter
description: The roller-wheel lighter in lacquer and gold finish, introduced as a design icon in 1957.

name: Datejust 36
description: The Rolex Oyster Perpetual Datejust is a self-winding chronometer manufactured by Rolex. Launched in 1945, the Datejust was the first self-winding chronometer wristwatch to indicate the date in a window on the dial.

name: Constellation
description: A dress watch family with the Manhattan bracelet and the claws on the case, dating from 1952 and certified as a chronometer.

name: Overseas
description: A sports-elegant watch with a Maltese-cross bezel, interchangeable straps and an in-house automatic movement.

name: Explorer
description: The Rolex Explorer is a line of sports watches manufactured by Rolex, introduced in 1953. It is self-winding, water-resistant and was originally designed as a tool watch to aid mountaineers.

name: Portugieser Chronograph
description: A large-dial chronograph with railway-track minutes and slim leaf hands, inspired by the marine chronometers of Portuguese merchants.

name: Big Bang
description: A chronograph that fuses materials: a ceramic or carbon case with a rubber strap, and screws on the bezel.

name: Constance
description: A structured shoulder bag with the large H clasp, in smooth leather with a flap that closes over the body.

name: Boy Bag
description: A quilted leather flap bag with an angular silhouette, a metal clasp and a chain strap.

name: Jodie
description: A knotted shoulder bag in woven intrecciato leather, with a rounded shape and no visible logo.

name: Galleria Saffiano
description: A structured saffiano leather bag with a double zip, a lasting symbol of the Milanese house.

name: Kate Chain Bag
description: A flap shoulder bag with a long chain and a leather tassel, in smooth calfskin.

name: Book Tote
description: A large tote in embroidered Dior Oblique canvas, with a book-like shape.

name: Centenary 21in Trolley Case
description: Globe-Trotter is a British manufacturer of luxury luggage, based in Mayfair, founded in 1897. The company operates from a factory in Hertfordshire where it employs 70 employees to make their luggage by hand.

name: Black Orchid Eau de Parfum
description: A dark floral fragrance built on black truffle, ylang-ylang and patchouli.

name: Baccarat Rouge 540
description: An amber, floral and woody fragrance with saffron and cedar, in a crystal-clear bottle.

name: Gypsy Water
description: A woody fragrance with juniper, incense and vanilla, from the Stockholm niche house.

name: Santal 33
description: A smoky sandalwood and cedar fragrance with leather and cardamom, blended to order in New York.

name: Snowdon Sunglasses
description: Angular acetate sunglasses with a metal T hinge, made in Italy.

name: Oversized Square Sunglasses
description: Oversized square acetate sunglasses with the interlocking G on the temples.

name: Linea Rossa Sunglasses
description: Sport-inspired sunglasses with the red line on the temple that defines the Linea Rossa range.

name: Happy Diamonds Pendant
description: A gold pendant with diamonds that move freely between sapphire crystals, a Chopard idea since 1976.

name: Possession Ring
description: A gold ring with a rotating band, the Swiss jeweller's best-known design since the 1970s.

name: Cable Classic Bracelet
description: A sterling silver bracelet twisted from a single cable, the American designer's signature motif.

name: T1 Bracelet
description: A hinged 18-carat gold bracelet with the Tiffany T motif in clean geometric lines.

name: Madame 101801 Coat
description: The camel hair wrap coat first made in 1981, with a relaxed shape and a self belt.

name: Expedition Parka
description: A down parka built for Arctic conditions, with a fur-trimmed hood and a windproof shell.

name: O'Connor Suit
description: A wool suit with a peak lapel and a trim, structured cut, made in Italy for the American designer.

name: Cashmere Polo Sweater
description: A cashmere sweater with a polo collar and ribbed trims, made in Italy from fine yarn.

name: Lopez Loafer
description: A hand-lasted penny loafer in polished calf with a leather sole from the London bootmaker.

name: Rockstud Pump
description: A pointed patent pump with a strap of small pyramid studs, the house's best-known detail.

name: Triple S
description: A chunky triple-sole sneaker in mesh and nubuck that popularised oversized footwear in the 2010s.

name: Tabi Ankle Boot
description: A split-toe leather ankle boot inspired by the Japanese tabi sock, with a block heel.

name: Intrecciato Card Case
description: A slim card case in woven intrecciato leather, finished with a leather lining.

name: Meisterstück 6cc Wallet
description: A saffiano leather wallet with six card slots, a coin pocket and the Montblanc emblem.

name: Soho Notebook
description: A pocket notebook in grained leather with gilded page edges, from the British stationer.

name: Homo Sapiens Fountain Pen
description: A fountain pen in resin mixed with volcanic basalt from Mount Etna, with a palladium nib.
